- [RARC.3.3.3] **Cross-process integrator-bridged.** The
  lower tier's stream-cb encodes the
  `ACTION_PUBLISH` payload (the integrator picks the
  encoding — protobuf, JSON-over-HTTP, gRPC,
  whatever fits the deployment) and forwards to a
  remote process. That process's integrator-side
  transport receives the payload and asserts into
  the local engine via a direct assert. libds
  has no protocol surface; the transport is
  entirely the integrator's design.
